metadata.question: Was the mean NDSI for Mount Fuji lower in December 2020 than December 2019?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (COPERNICUS/S2_SR) over a 10 km buffer around Mount Fuji summit (Point: 138.7274E, 35.3606N) for December 2019 and December 2020. If a month has zero images, fallback to Landsat 8 L2 (LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2).
2. Masking strategy: For Sentinel-2, mask SCL classes of cloud/shadow (3,8,9,10) but keep snow (11). For Landsat 8 L2, mask QA_PIXEL bits for dilated cloud, cirrus, cloud, and cloud shadow; keep snow. Compute NDSI = (green - SWIR) / (green + SWIR); sentinel bands B3/B11; landsat bands SR_B3/SR_B6 (with scale/offset applied).
3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error: If collection size is 0 after fallback -> C1. If mean reduceRegion returns null due to masking -> C2. If mean is non-finite or outside [-1,1] -> C3. Otherwise compare means: if 2020 < 2019 -> A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // Helpers
    const getInfoAsync = (eeObj) =>
      new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.getInfo(resolve, reject));

    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const roi = ee.Geometry.Point([138.7274, 35.3606]).buffer(10000); // 10 km around Mount Fuji
    const scale = 1000;

    // 2. Masking and NDSI helpers
    function maskS2(img) {
      const scl = img.select('SCL');
      const mask = scl.neq(3) // cloud shadow
        .and(scl.neq(8)) // cloud medium prob
        .and(scl.neq(9)) // cloud high prob
        .and(scl.neq(10)); // thin cirrus
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addNDSI_S2(img) {
      const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('NDSI');
      return img.addBands(ndsi);
    }
    function scaleL8sr(img) {
      // Apply scale and offset to SR bands
      const bands = ['SR_B2','SR_B3','SR_B4','SR_B5','SR_B6','SR_B7'];
      const scaled = img.select(bands).multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2);
      return img.addBands(scaled, null, true);
    }
    function maskL8(img) {
      const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
      const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 1).eq(0) // dilated cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 2).eq(0))      // cirrus
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0))      // cloud
        .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0));     // cloud shadow
      return img.updateMask(mask);
    }
    function addNDSI_L8(img) {
      const ndsi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('NDSI');
      return img.addBands(ndsi);
    }

    async function monthStats(year) {
      const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 1);
      const end = start.advance(1, 'month');

      // Primary: Sentinel-2 SR
      let source = 'S2_SR';
      let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR')
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .filterBounds(roi);
      let size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());

      if (!size || size === 0) {
        // Fallback: Landsat 8 L2
        source = 'L8_L2';
        col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
          .filterDate(start, end)
          .filterBounds(roi);
        size = await getInfoAsync(col.size());
        if (!size || size === 0) {
          return { status: 'C1', source, size: 0 };
        }
      }

      let processed;
      if (source === 'S2_SR') {
        processed = col.map(maskS2).map(addNDSI_S2);
      } else {
        processed = col.map(scaleL8sr).map(maskL8).map(addNDSI_L8);
      }

      const composite = processed.median().select('NDSI').clip(roi);
      const validCount = await getInfoAsync(
        composite.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('NDSI')
      );
      const totalCount = await getInfoAsync(
        ee.Image(1).rename('NDSI').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('NDSI')
      );
      if (!validCount || validCount === 0) {
        return { status: 'C2', source, size, validCount: 0, totalCount: totalCount || 0 };
      }

      const mean = await getInfoAsync(
        composite.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(),
          geometry: roi,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('NDSI')
      );

      if (mean === null || mean === undefined || !isFinite(mean) || mean < -1.0 || mean > 1.0) {
        return { status: 'C3', source, size, validCount, totalCount, mean };
      }
      return { status: 'OK', source, size, validCount, totalCount, mean };
    }

    // 3. Run for both months
    const s2019 = await monthStats(2019);
    const s2020 = await monthStats(2020);

    // 4. Print concise evidence
    if (s2019.status === 'C1' || s2020.status === 'C1') {
      console.log(`2019 Dec: Source=${s2019.source || 'NA'}, Images=${s2019.size || 0}`);
      console.log(`2020 Dec: Source=${s2020.source || 'NA'}, Images=${s2020.size || 0}`);
      console.log('One or both months have empty collections.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    if (s2019.status === 'C2' || s2020.status === 'C2') {
      console.log(`2019 Dec: Source=${s2019.source}, Images=${s2019.size}, Valid px=${s2019.validCount || 0}/${s2019.totalCount || 0}`);
      console.log(`2020 Dec: Source=${s2020.source}, Images=${s2020.size}, Valid px=${s2020.validCount || 0}/${s2020.totalCount || 0}`);
      console.log('No valid pixels after masking in at least one month.');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    if (s2019.status === 'C3' || s2020.status === 'C3') {
      console.log(`2019 Dec: Source=${s2019.source}, Images=${s2019.size}, Mean NDSI=${s2019.mean}`);
      console.log(`2020 Dec: Source=${s2020.source}, Images=${s2020.size}, Mean NDSI=${s2020.mean}`);
      console.log('Calculation returned invalid result (null/NaN/out-of-range).');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    console.log(`2019 Dec: Source=${s2019.source}, Images=${s2019.size}, Valid px=${s2019.validCount}/${s2019.totalCount} (${((s2019.validCount/s2019.totalCount)*100).toFixed(1)}%), Mean NDSI=${s2019.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    console.log(`2020 Dec: Source=${s2020.source}, Images=${s2020.size}, Valid px=${s2020.validCount}/${s2020.totalCount} (${((s2020.validCount/s2020.totalCount)*100).toFixed(1)}%), Mean NDSI=${s2020.mean.toFixed(3)}`);
    const isLower = s2020.mean < s2019.mean;
    console.log(`Comparison: 2020 < 2019 ? ${isLower}`);
    console.log(isLower ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Error:', err);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}
```
